title: Semantic watermark audit: code and records for "What Does a Semantic Watermark Verify? An Audit of SEAL and a Tested Thumbnail Repair Candidate"
description: Evaluation code, saved numerical records and the paper PDF for an audit of SEAL (ICCV 2025), a semantic watermark for Stable Diffusion images, against CSI semantic forgeries. One command recomputes every number cited in the paper from the saved records. The paper PDF is in paper/semantic-watermark-audit.pdf.
